labelLens.subtitle: Analyze whole foods, cooked dishes, and packaged nutrition labels with Gemini Vision AI.
labelLens.disclaimer: Label Lens provides nutrition education and does not diagnose health conditions.
labelLens.uploadSubtitle: Upload photos of whole foods, home-cooked dishes, or packaged nutrition labels (JPG, PNG, WEBP, up to 10MB)
labelLens.dragActive: Drop the food or nutrition label image here...
labelLens.culinaryDisclaimer: Image-based nutrition estimates for cooked meals are approximate. Actual values vary based on cooking oils, portion weight, and specific household recipes.
labelLens.wholeFoodNote: Standard clinical reference values per 100g. Fresh whole foods contain natural intrinsic sugars and zero added industrial sugars.
labelLens.packagedNoLabelNote: Exact packaged nutrition values require a readable label or reliable product data. Photograph the printed Nutrition Facts table for verified numbers.
labelLens.nonFoodGuidance: Please upload a clear, well-lit photo of a whole food, cooked meal, or packaged food label.
labelLens.ocrReading: Scanning food and reading visual features...
labelLens.ocrFailed: We couldn't reliably read this image.
labelLens.ocrFailedTip: Lighting, angles, or blur can affect image analysis. You can take another photo or enter values manually below.
labelLens.indicatorsSubtitle: Objective dietary flags based on balanced nutrition guidelines
labelLens.manualFormSubtitle: Type or adjust values directly from your food packaging
labelLens.cameraDenied: Camera permission was denied or unavailable. Please upload a file instead.
labelLens.cameraInstructions: Position whole food, dish, or nutrition facts panel clearly inside the frame.
labelLens.errorInvalidType: Unsupported file format. Please upload a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image.
labelLens.errorTooLarge: Image size exceeds 10MB limit. Please upload a smaller photo.
labelLens.educationalNote: Educational Nutrition Grade — based on balanced nutrient composition guidelines (sugar, saturated fat, sodium vs protein and fiber). Not an official regulatory mark.
